wholeTreeFingerprint.algorithm: SHA-256 of the complete LF-terminated SHA256SUMS manifest, whose source-relative paths are sorted bytewise with LC_ALL=C

copy.method: Complete archive-mode file copy with hidden files and file modes preserved

sourceComparison.method: Recursive diff plus archive-mode rsync dry-run with itemized changes
sourceComparison.result: The source and copied upstream trees have no file-content, path, mode, timestamp, or tree-entry differences.

verification.manifestAlgorithm: Regular files beneath upstream are sorted by POSIX-relative path with LC_ALL=C. Each LF-terminated manifest line is lowercase SHA-256, two ASCII spaces, then the relative path.
